mode: Read-only reference. No production screenshots stored. Lab scores were not changed.
accounts: Three authorized client accounts signed in through the normal sign-in form, one attempt after the form was ready. Remember-me was left off. A visible Log out or Sign out control was not confirmed; each session was ended with the app logout endpoint, which returned HTTP 200.
shell: Client navigation included Dashboard, Requests, Projects, Quotes, Messages, Billing (/payments), Invoices, Notifications, Blog, Portfolio, Profile, and Settings.
The shell exposed a collapsible sidebar, a Search control, a theme control, Messages, Notifications, and Account. The theme control was not activated, so dark production appearance was not reviewed.
The Search control was visible. Opening a command palette was not confirmed.

At 1440×1000 and 390×844, reviewed section roots for accounts A and B had no document horizontal overflow. A mobile menu control was present; opening it was not treated as proof that navigation succeeds.

axe-core 4.10.2 reported four serious color-contrast nodes on each of eight account A pages. Node text was not stored. This is a diagnostic, not a WCAG conformance result. The repeated count is consistent with shared chrome.
A sampled Tab sequence was inconclusive and is not a keyboard pass or fail.
routes_reviewed: /dashboard — heading Overview; sections included Workspace vitals, Awaiting you, Live workbench, Quotes to review, and Recent activity. Awaiting tabs included Quotes, Pay now, Projects, and Inbox.
/requests — heading Work Hub; tabs All, Requests, and Projects; link to the new-request form.
/requests/new — heading New request; empty form controls were present, including text, select, number, date, checkbox, and textarea. Nothing was entered or saved.
/projects — heading Projects. No project detail page was opened.
/quotes — heading Quotes. No quote detail page was opened.
/messages, /messages/inbox, and /messages/new/direct — message home and new-message route. No message was sent and no thread was opened.
/payments and /payments/methods — billing and payment-methods pages on accounts A and B. No method was added and Pay now was not activated.
/invoices — heading Invoices, with an Invoice archive section. Nothing was downloaded.
/notifications — center opened on accounts A and B only. Items were not opened.
/profile — route opened inside the shell on all three accounts, but no h1 or profile fields were confirmed.
/settings/account, /settings/security, /settings/activity, and /settings/files — routes opened. No password, security, notification, or file change was made.
not_reviewed: Request, project, quote, and payment detail pages.
Checkout and any Pay now action.
Account C billing page was not reopened; A and B had already shown the same billing routes.
side_effect: Opening /notifications for accounts A and B was followed by POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all, which returned HTTP 201. That was not an intentional mark-read click, and it was not repeated. Account C's notifications page was not opened; that session's recorded writes were only sign-in, refresh, and logout.
other_observations: GET /api/auth/impersonate returned HTTP 204. No impersonation control was used.
Public blog, portfolio, contact, and register pages were reachable from marketing links. No register or contact form was submitted. They are not lab-family equivalents.
No payment, upload, approval, delete, or message send was performed.
